summary: Design a public sector innovation lab with practical tools, governance, and KPIs. Learn through hands-on exercises. Enquire now.
lede: Public sector innovation lab design helps public service professionals structure labs that turn service challenges into tested pilots. Participants practice challenge framing, stakeholder mapping, service blueprinting and prototype planning, alongside governance and learning measures such as pilot backlogs and KPI dashboards. The course is for innovation managers, policy analysts, service designers and digital transformation leads coordinating experiments across teams.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals working on public sector innovation lab design, service improvement, and pilot delivery. It is especially relevant if you help shape innovation portfolios, coordinate cross-agency work, or translate service challenges into practical experiments. Public sector innovation managers who need to structure lab operations. Policy analysts who frame service challenges for experimentation. Service designers working on citizen-facing government journeys. Digital transformation leads coordinating innovation across agencies. Programme officers managing pilots, prototypes, and delivery milestones. Public administration advisors supporting reform and modernisation. Delivery unit staff tracking adoption and implementation risks. Monitoring and evaluation specialists measuring pilot outcomes. Frontline service improvement leads capturing operational pain points. Cross-functional project coordinators supporting public innovation portfolios.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, a current service challenge, and any available notes on existing programmes, citizen feedback, or pilot ideas. Familiarity with basic public-sector project language, stakeholder structures, and service delivery processes will help you complete the lab exercises with confidence.
